newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein to go to Washington for summit.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein to go to Washington for summit.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan plans to leave for Washington on Monday to attend a summit aimed at salvaging Middle East peace following bloody Arab-Israeli clashes, a government official said on Sunday.

U.S. President Bill Clinton will announce the summit, to take place in Washington on Tuesday, they added. It will be attended by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
